proposed_comments.title: Use a unique identity for observable notification routing

confidence.rationale: The current SDK notification payload still routes property changes by commandId, while item observables and nested command/page observables can share that identifier. The unresolved Copilot thread remains open at ObservableBase.ts.

proposed_comments.body:
### Use a unique identity for observable notification routing

**Severity:** `high`

`commandId` does not uniquely identify the observable object: `CommandItemBase` and `ListItemBase` use their nested command ID, while the nested command or page proxy registers that same ID with the host. When properties overlap, an item update can therefore mutate its nested command or page, and vice versa. Include a distinct observable-object ID or target kind in the notification payload and registry key, then add coverage proving updates route only to the originating object.

proposed_comments.title: Enforce manifest engines.node before launching extensions

confidence.rationale: JSExtensionWrapper launches the first resolved node.exe while the manifest engines.node requirement is parsed but not enforced. The unresolved Copilot thread remains open at JSExtensionWrapper.cs.

proposed_comments.body:
### Enforce manifest engines.node before launching extensions

**Severity:** `high`

The manifest's `engines.node` requirement is parsed but not enforced before launch. The SDK and sample require Node >=22, but the host accepts the first `node.exe` on PATH; npm can install with only an engine warning, so an extension can later fail at runtime with unsupported syntax or APIs. Resolve the runtime version before launch and reject or surface a clear error when it does not satisfy the manifest range.
